interface_schema.compatibility: Recorder v1 action terminology, lifecycle identity and frame rules are constrained by Interface v1
interface_schema.sha256_recording_rule: each future run manifest records the exact loaded Interface contract SHA-256

identity_contract.run_id_semantics: run_id is a team-local UUID produced by CompetitionRunCoordinator, not a stable official Server evaluation identity
identity_contract.client_restart_semantics: a Client restart can produce a different run_id even while the same physical official game continues
identity_contract.task_set_merge_rule: two run_id values must never be merged solely because task_set_fingerprint matches

local_attempt_key.settled_attempt_count_semantics: number of already settled attempts; not the current 1-based attempt number

logical_entities.name: Team-local Run
logical_entities.semantics: one locally identified run fragment bound to one run_id

logical_entities.name: Official Task
logical_entities.semantics: one task selected by public CompetitionContext

logical_entities.name: Official Attempt
logical_entities.semantics: official attempt whose public start identity remains unresolved

logical_entities.name: Recorder Segment
logical_entities.semantics: one local raw recording process segment; not an Official Attempt and not a Training Episode

logical_entities.name: Training Episode
logical_entities.semantics: learning unit derived by Commit C offline Indexer and QC

canonical_roles.dataset_root: owner-selected root containing all Recorder artifacts
canonical_roles.bootstrap: segments created before a valid run_id is available
canonical_roles.recovery: recovery reports or derived repaired views that never overwrite raw artifacts
canonical_roles.legacy: logical compatibility role for existing flat directories; relocation is not required

bootstrap_segment.semantics: raw segment that has never been bound to a valid run_id

run_bound_segment.parent_run_id_rule: must be a non-empty run_id known when the segment is created

field_descriptor_contract.nullable_rule: every nullable field defines null_semantics and unavailable_representation

recorder_schema_sha256.semantics: SHA-256 of the exact Recorder contract used for this run

interface_schema_version.semantics: Interface major version governing this recording

interface_schema_sha256.semantics: SHA-256 of the exact Interface contract used for this run

run_id.semantics: team-local run identity; not an official Server evaluation identity

task_set_fingerprint.semantics: fingerprint of the complete task set; never sufficient to merge distinct run_id values

project_commit.semantics: project Git commit, or a structured unavailable value when source metadata is absent

project_branch.semantics: project branch, or a structured unavailable value

dirty_worktree.semantics: whether the source worktree was dirty, or a structured unavailable value

config_sha256.semantics: hash of the exact loaded configuration, or structured unavailable value

official_server_image_id.semantics: official Server image identity; unavailable when not injected and never queried through Docker socket

official_client_image_id.semantics: official Client image identity; unavailable when not injected and never queried through Docker socket

ros_domain_id.semantics: ROS domain used by the Recorder process, or structured unavailable value

rmw_implementation.semantics: RMW implementation selected by the Recorder process, or structured unavailable value

observe_only.semantics: whether the Client is globally observe-only

official_publish_enabled.semantics: whether creation and use of official publishers was authorized

start_ros_ns.semantics: nonnegative ROS timestamp at run-bound recording start

end_ros_ns.semantics: nonnegative ROS timestamp at run recording end
end_ros_ns.null_semantics: run has not reached a recorded end

start_wall_utc.semantics: UTC wall time at run-bound recording start

end_wall_utc.semantics: UTC wall time at run recording end
end_wall_utc.null_semantics: run has not reached a recorded end

recorder_segment_ids.semantics: ordered unique segment identities belonging to this run; entries may only be appended

clean_shutdown.semantics: true only after the complete shutdown protocol; false when unclean state is detected
clean_shutdown.null_semantics: shutdown outcome is not yet known

shutdown_reason.semantics: controlled reason for clean or detected unclean termination
shutdown_reason.null_semantics: shutdown has not been requested or detected

recovery_required.semantics: whether an immutable recovery report or derived view is required
recovery_required.null_semantics: shutdown outcome is not yet known

provenance_warnings.semantics: ordered machine-readable warnings for unavailable, redacted or conflicting provenance

cross_field_rules: pid is diagnostic only and never an identity
a Recorder Segment must never be named or interpreted as an episode

parent_run_id.source: valid CompetitionContext available at segment creation
parent_run_id.semantics: team-local parent run; null only for bootstrap
parent_run_id.null_semantics: segment_kind is bootstrap and no valid run was bound

segment_kind.semantics: whether the segment was created before or after run binding

segment_sequence.semantics: nonnegative order within a process/run scope

first_ros_timestamp_ns.semantics: minimum observed ROS timestamp, not wall or monotonic time
first_ros_timestamp_ns.null_semantics: no timestamped ROS record has been persisted

last_ros_timestamp_ns.semantics: maximum observed ROS timestamp under the documented rollback policy
last_ros_timestamp_ns.null_semantics: no timestamped ROS record has been persisted

pid.semantics: diagnostic process ID; never a run, segment or writer identity

container_identity.semantics: optional disabled, redacted or injected container identity; Docker socket access is forbidden

clean_shutdown.null_semantics: segment is active or termination was not yet evaluated

shutdown_reason.null_semantics: shutdown has not been requested or detected

bag_path.semantics: segment-relative bag path when bag recording was requested
bag_path.null_semantics: bag recording was disabled or failed before a path was committed

bag_storage_identifier.semantics: rosbag2 storage plugin identifier, or structured unavailable value

bag_exit_code.null_semantics: bag was not started or its exit was not observed

jsonl_artifacts.semantics: unique relative JSONL path, record schema and optional final hash for each artifact

message_counters.semantics: diagnostic persisted callback counts; not proof of bag completeness

dropped_counters.semantics: known dropped record counts grouped by controlled reason

pairing_counters.semantics: paired, issue and orphan diagnostic counters

warning_counters.semantics: controlled warning counts without unbounded raw exception content

observed_task_ids.semantics: ordered unique Official Task identities observed in this segment

observed_settled_attempt_counts.semantics: ordered unique settled attempt counts; never current 1-based attempt numbers

context_valid_count.semantics: number of persisted contexts with valid=true

context_invalid_count.semantics: number of persisted invalid contexts; invalid contexts never replace the last valid identity

event_schema.derived_event_source_rule: derived events must reference source_event_ids or a source message identity in payload

event_id.semantics: stable unique event identity within one recorder_segment_id

event_timestamp_ns.source: source record timestamp or Recorder ROS clock
event_timestamp_ns.semantics: nonnegative semantic event time in the documented source clock

receive_timestamp_ns.source: Recorder ROS clock at callback receipt

receive_monotonic_ns.semantics: process-local wait and arrival diagnostic only; forbidden for cross-process ordering

monotonic_scope.semantics: scope within which receive_monotonic_ns may be compared

run_id.semantics: team-local run identity at the event; null in bootstrap or when unbound
run_id.null_semantics: no valid run identity was bound

task_id.semantics: Official Task identity at the event
task_id.null_semantics: no valid active task was bound

settled_attempt_count.semantics: already settled attempts, not a current 1-based attempt number
settled_attempt_count.null_semantics: no valid run/task context was bound

local_attempt_key.source: Recorder from last valid run_id, task_id and settled_attempt_count
local_attempt_key.semantics: team-local tuple (run_id, task_id, settled_attempt_count), never an official attempt_id
local_attempt_key.null_semantics: one or more key components are unavailable

source.semantics: source topic, artifact, message identity and whether the event is raw or derived

invalid_reasons.semantics: bounded reasons; empty only when validity is valid

source_event_ids.semantics: source event identities for a derived event; raw events use an empty array and payload message identity

raw_artifact_schema.high_bandwidth_storage: RGB, Depth, CameraInfo, Odom and JointState remain raw rosbag messages

samples_jsonl.owner: Commit C offline Indexer and QC

current_implementation.publisher_failure_reason: ActionDispatchRecord aggregate and group failure reasons
current_implementation.execution_feedback: JointState and Odom in rosbag, not yet paired to actions

action_recording_schema.head_only_exact_payload_source: ActionDispatchRecord exact payload; never reconstructed from FinalAction or JointState
action_recording_schema.publisher_success_disclaimer: publisher_call_succeeded does not prove DDS delivery, Server receipt, controller acceptance or robot execution

controller_accepted.reason: no authoritative Server or controller acknowledgement

execution_confirmed.reason: later JointState/Odom have no frozen confirmation tolerance or pairing window

markers.ACTIVE: created and durably recorded when a future segment starts
markers.COMPLETE: created only after artifacts, bag outcome and final metadata are durably recorded

shutdown_schema.unclean_detection_owner: a later Recorder startup or offline recovery scan

jsonl_recovery.incomplete_final_tail: may be excluded only in a derived recovery view
jsonl_recovery.interior_corruption: must fail closed and must never be silently ignored

rosbag_schema.action_dispatch_storage: structured action_dispatches.jsonl; duplicate rosbag recording is not required by v1

legacy_compatibility.detection_rule: a flat Recorder directory without a Recorder schema identity is read as legacy_flat_episode_v0
legacy_compatibility.legacy_metadata_task_semantics: metadata.task is a first-task compatibility field and must not be treated as the complete task set
legacy_compatibility.migration_output_rule: migration or unified views are written to a new output directory

schema_evolution.same_major_addition_rule: only fields with explicit missing semantics may be added compatibly
schema_evolution.new_event_rule: a new controlled event type must declare introduced_in
schema_evolution.unknown_field_reader_behavior: preserve when possible without changing known field interpretation
schema_evolution.migration_rule: write a new output with source and destination schema hashes and migration tool version

planned_runtime_capabilities.capability: run manifests, bootstrap/run-bound segments and events.jsonl
ACTIVE/COMPLETE markers and unclean recovery detection
raw index, samples, next_observation and training eligibility

unresolved.required_test_or_decision: define an authoritative continuity source or explicit offline review policy
unresolved.must_not_assume: matching task_set_fingerprint proves two run_id values are one run

unresolved.required_test_or_decision: record TF and compare official world task coordinates

unresolved.required_test_or_decision: obtain or add authoritative Server-side receipt evidence

unresolved.why_unresolved: no accepted feedback tolerance or settling rule is frozen
unresolved.required_test_or_decision: calibrate feedback tolerances and settling windows

unresolved.required_test_or_decision: measure timestamp and receive-time skew in recorded runs
unresolved.must_not_assume: nearest timestamp is always the correct observation or feedback

unresolved.required_test_or_decision: assign injection ownership and define accepted image ID/digest format
unresolved.must_not_assume: Recorder can query Docker or infer image identity
